svg.title: King’s College, Cambridge — complete visible Chapel and college buildings
svg.desc: Architecture clipped from the supplied Cambridge photograph, including the Chapel’s roof pinnacles and west towers, both flanking buildings, chimney caps, roof corners and the complete left retaining wall. The original sky, lawn, river, bridge, foreground path and unrelated far-right background fragment are excluded.
svg.metadata: Selected user-provided photograph, authorized for this portfolio task. Photo derivative: 1024 × 238 pixels, source coordinates x0–1024 and y250–488; metadata removed and JPEG compressed. Native vector clipping changes transparency only and retains the photographic architecture. No generated architecture, perspective warping, ownership claim or additional license claim.
